title: System settings
description: Settings that control how the server works. Changes take effect in every process within 15–30 seconds; no restart needed.
confirmReset: Reset this setting to its default value?
secretsNote: Passwords, encryption keys, ports and connection addresses are not shown here for security reasons: they stay in the server’s .env file.

photos.title: Photo downloads
photos.description: Speed and order of downloading photos from terminals by link.

push.title: Push intake
push.description: Limits for receiving events from terminals (push server).

lag.title: Lagging terminal
lag.description: If push falls behind, the server pulls events and photos from the terminal itself.

live.title: Real-time view
live.description: Which passes are shown on the real-time page.

calendar.title: Default school week
calendar.description: Used when a school or class has no weekly schedule. Holiday and vacation rules and any entered weekly schedule take priority. If you enter a quarter break as “students only”, teachers stay on working days.

events.title: Cleaning up old events
events.description: For past days only each person’s first entry and last exit are kept; the other events are deleted.

photosConcurrency.label: Parallel downloads
photosConcurrency.hint: How many photos are downloaded from one terminal at the same time. Terminals are small devices; more than 3 is not recommended.

photosWorkers.label: Terminals processed at once
photosWorkers.hint: How many terminals the photo download queue works on at the same time. Raise it when you have many terminals (usually 4–8) and watch the server network and MySQL load.

photosBatchSize.label: Batch size
photosBatchSize.hint: How many photos are taken from the queue per request.

photosMaxBatches.label: Batches per run
photosMaxBatches.hint: Maximum batches per terminal each minute.

photosRunSeconds.label: Run duration
photosRunSeconds.hint: No new batch starts after this time; the next run begins a minute later.

pushSavePictures.label: Save photos sent with push
pushSavePictures.hint: If off, photos are downloaded later by link only.

pushMaxRpsPerTerminal.label: Request limit per terminal
pushMaxRpsPerTerminal.hint: One terminal may send this many requests per second; extra ones are rejected.

pushMaxBacklog.label: Queue limit
pushMaxBacklog.hint: If unprocessed events exceed this, the server temporarily stops accepting new ones.

pushLagReconcile.label: Auto-pull from lagging terminal
pushLagReconcile.hint: If push falls behind, the server pulls today’s events from the terminal itself.

pushLagMinutes.label: Lag threshold
pushLagMinutes.hint: If an event arrives older than this, the terminal is considered lagging.

pushPhotoLookup.label: Look up photos for events without one
pushPhotoLookup.hint: If push arrives without a photo, the server asks the terminal for the photo link.

pushPhotoLookupDays.label: Photo lookup window
pushPhotoLookupDays.hint: Photos are looked up for events within this many days.

liveMaxAgeMinutes.label: Max age of events in the live feed
liveMaxAgeMinutes.hint: Older passes (from the backlog) do not enter the live feed; counters still update.

calendarPrimaryMaxGrade.label: Primary grades (up to this grade)
calendarPrimaryMaxGrade.hint: Grades up to this one (inclusive) count as primary and have a shorter week. A teacher who teaches only these grades also follows the primary week.

calendarPrimaryWeekDays.label: Primary grades: school days per week
calendarPrimaryWeekDays.hint: This many days starting Monday: 5 = Mon–Fri, 6 = Mon–Sat.

calendarGeneralWeekDays.label: Other grades and teachers: school days per week
calendarGeneralWeekDays.hint: This many days starting Monday: 5 = Mon–Fri, 6 = Mon–Sat.

eventCompactEnabled.label: Enable cleanup
eventCompactEnabled.hint: When off, nothing is deleted (only the dry run works). Runs once a week, on Sunday night.

eventCompactKeepDays.label: Full retention period
eventCompactKeepDays.hint: Days older than this are cleaned. Recent days are never touched.

compaction.title: Cleaning up old events
compaction.description: attendance_events only: for past days each person keeps their very first entry and very last exit. The daily attendance table (daily_attendance) is not touched. Photo files of deleted events are removed too.
compaction.previewResult: On {{date}}, {{schools}} random schools: of {{events}} events, {{removable}} ({{percent}}%) would be deleted. Nothing was deleted.
compaction.previewEmpty: No events found in the sampled schools on {{date}}.
compaction.confirmText: For days older than {{days}} days each person keeps only the first entry and last exit; the other events and their photos are deleted. This cannot be undone.
